scripts.e2e: tsx e2e/preflight.ts && next build && playwright test
scripts.ext:build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('extension/dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p extension/tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),d='extension/dist/';fs.copyFileSync('extension/manifest.json',d+'manifest.json');fs.writeFileSync(d+'commands.js','export default '+fs.readFileSync('src/lib/bridge/commands.json','utf8').trim()+'\n');const r=d+'relay.js',s=fs.readFileSync(r,'utf8'),t=s.replace('../../src/lib/bridge/commands.json','./commands.js');if(t===s)throw new Error('relay.js에서 commands.json import를 찾지 못했다');fs.writeFileSync(r,t)"
scripts.ext-erp:build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('extension-erp/dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p extension-erp/tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['manifest.json','options.html'])fs.copyFileSync('extension-erp/'+f,'extension-erp/dist/'+f)"
